CVE-2026-114516.title: Etherpad: Pre-auth arbitrary file read
CVE-2026-114516.description: Etherpad is a real-time collaborative editor. From 1.8.14 until 3.3.3, the pre-authentication /static/* plugin asset handler in src/node/utils/Minify.ts performs a backslash-to-forward-slash conversion after src/node/utils/sanitizePathname.ts has completed its POSIX path checks. On POSIX systems the sanitizer correctly treats backslashes as ordinary filename bytes, but the later conversion turns encoded backslash-separated parent-directory segments into traversal components without revalidation or containment. The expressPreSession registration and the always-present ep_etherpad-lite core pseudo-plugin make this path reachable without credentials, allowing a remote attacker to read any file available to the Etherpad process. Disclosed configuration or environment secrets can expose administrator credentials, after which the administrator plugin installer can provide in-process code execution and full server compromise. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.3.

CVE-2026-115906.title: zip: AES Entry HMAC Authentication Bypass on Premature EOF
CVE-2026-115906.description: zip is a zip library for Rust that supports reading and writing simple ZIP files. From 0.6.0 until 9.0.0, the AES entry reader in src/aes.rs verifies its HMAC only when the attacker-controlled data counter reaches zero. If the underlying bounded reader reaches the real end of the archive while data_remaining is still positive, or if an encrypted entry has no payload, the reader can return a clean end of stream without reading and comparing the authentication tag. Applications using by_index_decrypt, by_name_decrypt, by_path_decrypt, or password-enabled by_index_with_options can therefore accept modified plaintext without an authentication error. This issue is fixed in version 9.0.0.

Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort in the jose library allows an attacker who obtains a password-encrypted private-key export to recover the private key through an offline password-cracking attack.

CVE-2026-99327.title: HID: roccat: kovaplus: reject short button reports
CVE-2026-99327.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: roccat: kovaplus: reject short button reports

The raw event callback runs before HID core validates and zero-pads the
report. It passes the buffer to helpers which inspect data[0] and read a
complete struct kovaplus_mouse_report_button for button reports. A
truncated report can therefore cause an out-of-bounds read.

Require enough data for the button report before calling either helper.
Commit 47669bec44fe ("HID: asus: refactor the two workqueues and init
sequence") added the same kind of raw-event length validation to hid-asus.
